title: 22.4.0 — Mobile-first editor UI overhaul (panel rewrite)

user_request.raw: tüm paneli düzelt, ekranı kontrol edemiyorum kayma oluyor, ekran küçücük mobil için uyarla, kullanım çok zor; araçlar kötü çalışıyor gerekirse baştan yaz, arayüzü düzelt.
diagnosis_from_screenshot: Spatial-menu toolbar reserves a 1100×45 ScrollContainer → horizontal drag on the top band scrolls the TOOLBAR (the 'kayma'), and on a phone most controls live off-screen.
asset_manager_panel (430×360 fixed) floats over the already-tiny 3D viewport; with the toolbar band + Godot chrome the viewport is a thin strip — 'ekranı kontrol edemiyorum'.
Touch targets (24-31px) under Android editor minimums; slider rows too wide to reach.

architecture_decisions.ADR-021-1: Spatial menu shrinks to TWO buttons (Fırça AÇIK/KAPALI + 🏔 Panel). The 1100px ScrollContainer is deleted outright — nothing in the top band scrolls, the viewport regains the full row height.
architecture_decisions.ADR-021-2: ALL tool controls move into ONE unified left-edge panel (editor/ui/terrain_panel.gd, new class TerrainPanel): full-height anchored, 340px wide, tabs Fırça / Varlıklar / Chunk'lar, header ✕ to dismiss. Hidden by default so the viewport starts free; state mirrored on the 🏔 toggle.
architecture_decisions.ADR-021-3: Plugin KEEPS ownership of all control member vars and handlers (tool_opt, sliders, pickers…) — the panel is a dumb shell with tab roots the plugin fills. Zero handler churn = zero behaviour regression risk; asset_manager_panel var now IS the TerrainPanel so every existing hide/show/teardown call keeps working.
architecture_decisions.ADR-021-4: Touch ergonomics: every interactive row ≥ 38px min height, dropdowns full-width, slider+spinbox pairs share a row; tab contents scroll vertically inside the panel.

tasks.title: TerrainPanel shell (editor/ui/terrain_panel.gd): anchored left full-height, header(title+✕), TabContainer, scrolled tab factory, closed signal
plugin _build_main_ui rewrite: 2-button menu strip (brush toggle + panel toggle), delete 1100px scroll band
Brush tab: move tool/paint-mode/texture/object/shape/mask/radius/strength controls into panel rows; row-visibility replaces opt-visibility in _update_ui_visibility
Assets + Chunk tabs re-homed into TerrainPanel; _toggle_asset_manager drives panel + syncs toggle button; _edit refreshes open panel
Teardown/lifecycle audit: _exit_tree walk, _make_visible paths, mask-popup anchoring still valid
Quality gate: parse + 18-suite pipeline green, gdlint, 22.4.0, CHANGES, commit+push main, ship addon zip

risk_register.risk: Handler/control re-parenting breaks a signal path (silent dead control)
risk_register.mitigation: ADR-021-3: controls + handlers stay plugin-owned; only parents change. Grep-verify every member var is still constructed exactly once.

risk_register.risk: Panel overlay still eats the viewport
risk_register.mitigation: Hidden by default; 340px fixed width (~17% of a 2000px landscape); ✕ + menu toggle both dismiss.

risk_register.risk: Headless suite can't see UI regressions
risk_register.mitigation: Parse check + suite guard logic only; honest disclosure that layout needs a device pass — user IS the device tester and asked for this iteration.

quality_gate: PASS — 18/18 suites green post-rewrite; gdlint: terrain_panel.gd clean, plugin delta +1 finding in a pre-existing cosmetic category (class-definitions-order baseline 32→33)
honesty_audit: PASS with disclosure: layout/touch verification REQUIRES the Android device — headless covers parse + logic only. User performs the device pass; panel anchors/row heights are best-effort until then.
